EC1: Known hypersensitivity to egg [OR], soybean proteins [OR], peanut proteins [OR], corn [OR] or corn products [OR], or to any of the active substances [OR] or excipients
EC2: Severe hyperlipidemia [OR] or severe disorders of lipid metabolism [OR] characterized by hypertriglyceridemia (serum triglyceride concentration >1,000 g/dL).
EC3: Inborn errors of amino acid metabolism
EC4: Cardiopulmonary instability (including pulmonary edema [OR], cardiac insufficiency [OR], myocardial infarction [OR], acidosis [OR] and hemodynamic instability requiring significant vasopressor support)
EC6: PN in the last 7 days prior to study enrollment.
EC7: Need for chronic PN before study start
EC8: Liver enzymes [OR] (either AST [OR], ALT [OR], GGPT), or direct bilirubin exceeding 2 x upper limit of normal range
EC9: Pathologically altered level of any serum electrolyte (sodium [OR], potassium [OR], magnesium [OR], calcium [OR], chloride [OR], phosphate) unless corrected prior to the start of study treatment
EC10: Pathologically altered blood pH [OR], or oxygen saturation [OR], or carbon dioxide unless corrected prior to the start of study treatment
